title: Matterbridge Freebox Player (Delta / Revolution) plugin
description: Matterbridge plugin exposing the Freebox Player Delta (Devialet) and Revolution as Matter media devices via the FreeboxOS Player API.

host.title: Freebox host
host.description: Freebox API host (default: mafreebox.freebox.fr). Override with the LAN IP if mDNS / hosts resolution does not work.

appId.title: App ID
appId.description: Application identifier registered with the Freebox.

appToken.title: App Token
appToken.description: Persistent token returned by the Freebox after the user validated the app on the front panel. Leave empty on first start to trigger registration; the plugin will fill it once granted.

airplayPort.title: AirPlay TCP port
airplayPort.description: TCP port probed to detect if the player is ON. AirPlay default is 7000.

alternativeAirplayPort.title: Alternative AirPlay TCP port
alternativeAirplayPort.description: Fallback TCP port for power detection if 7000 is filtered (try 54243).

players.title: Players (manual override)
players.description: Optional list of players to expose. If empty, the plugin auto-discovers via the Freebox API. Each entry: { id, name, host }.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.
